items.title: fix(agents): include ctimeMs in workspace file cache identity (#127769)
items.summary: fix(agents): include ctimeMs in workspace file cache identity (#127769) A same-inode, equal-size in-place edit whose mtime is restored (via sync/restore/editor tooling) left the workspace bootstrap cache serving stale content for the lifetime of the process. ctimeMs is updated by the OS on every metadata change and cannot be restored via utimes, so adding it to the cache identity detects the edit. Matches the existing ctime freshness pattern in assistant-avatar-cache.ts and plugin-registry-snapshot.ts. Closes #127504

items.title: fix(outbound): prevent remote gateway duplicate sends (#128202)
items.summary: fix(outbound): prevent remote gateway duplicate sends (#128202) When the agent runtime talks to a remote Gateway (gateway.mode "remote" or a gatewayUrl/gatewayToken override), the message tool withholds the runtime identity, so a proven-not-sent outbound failure kept its durable retry row and also surfaced as an error the model would answer by resending — a duplicate once the queue replayed the row. - deliver-queue-execute: mark the thrown error recoveryOwnedRetry when the proven-not-sent row stays replay-eligible (one retry owner per row) - message.action: additive UNAVAILABLE detail code OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_QUEUED - message tool: project that error into a non-throwing delivery_queued result ("queued, will retry automatically, do not resend") and keep the autogenerated idempotency-key mapping so an identical resend collapses Validated with unit tests and a real-Telegram remote-gateway E2E (affected on main: duplicate; fixed: single send, delivery_queued). Closes #124279 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
